entries.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"}) RETURN a.degree_in AS degree_in, a.degree_out AS degree_out, a.degree_total AS degree_total, a.tx_in_count AS tx_in_count, a.tx_out_count AS tx_out_count, a.tx_total_count AS tx_total_count, a.total_volume_usd AS total_volume_usd, a.total_in_usd AS total_in_usd, a.total_out_usd AS total_out_usd, a.net_flow_usd AS net_flow_usd, a.first_activity_timestamp AS first_activity_timestamp, a.last_activity_timestamp AS last_activity_timestamp, a.activity_span_days AS activity_span_days LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"}) RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, a.labels AS display_labels, a.labels AS system_labels, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange, a.risk_score AS live_risk_score, a.risk_level AS live_risk_level, a.label_risk_labels AS label_risk_labels, a.label_risk_levels AS label_risk_levels, a.label_risk_updated_timestamps AS label_risk_updated_timestamps LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus\"quote"}) RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, a.labels AS display_labels, a.labels AS system_labels, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange, a.risk_score AS live_risk_score, a.risk_level AS live_risk_level, a.label_risk_labels AS label_risk_labels, a.label_risk_levels AS label_risk_levels, a.label_risk_updated_timestamps AS label_risk_updated_timestamps LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "corpus-address-b"}) RETURN p LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-b"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"}) RETURN p LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-b"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "corpus\"quote"}) RETURN p LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus\"quote"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "corpus-address-b"}) RETURN p LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 50

USE chain MATCH (b:Block {block_height: 79841521}) RETURN b.block_hash, b.block_date
USE chain MATCH (h:Head) RETURN h.block_height, h.age_seconds, h.warehouse_blocks_behind, h.graph_blocks_behind
USE chain MATCH (t:Transaction {tx_id: "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901"}) RETURN t.status, t.block_height, t.block_date

USE facts MATCH (s:Address {address: "0x4b9364c8553c519a419b259f022865071fd7bfdf"})-[x:SWAP]->(m:Address {address: "0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951"}) WHERE x.block_date = "2026-10-22" RETURN s.address AS from_address, m.address AS to_address, x.recipient AS recipient, x.tx_id AS tx_id, x.sold_asset AS sold_asset, x.bought_asset AS bought_asset LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "0x2459dedb3012d1e929edd17df26620120bdf11bf"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address {address: "0x220bbea2c59e2a1b0a71ffba694834e6822c0b52"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, a.labels AS labels, a.risk_score AS risk_score, a.risk_level AS risk_level, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWED_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[flow:FLOWED_TO]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWED_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"}) WHERE NOT dst:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWED_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWED_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT mid:Pool AND NOT mid:Protocol AND NOT mid:System AND NOT mid.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.address AS from_address, mid.address AS mid_address, dst.address AS to_address, 2 AS hops, type(r1) AS first_edge, type(r2) AS second_edge, coalesce(r1.amount_usd_sum, r1.bought_usd) AS first_amount_usd, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a) AS count LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT owned:Pool AND NOT owned:Protocol AND NOT owned:System AND NOT owned.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN a.address AS subject_address, owned.address AS linked_via_address, b.address AS counterparty_address, type(r) AS edge, coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, r.bought_usd) AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(r.tx_count, r.swap_count) AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x72e46c9edf828002fdbfdd0952419790576c0f18"}) RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels, a.is_contract AS is_contract LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (f:Address {address: "0xc63d7338c178e805c544b8f897066bd3bbcbe136"})-[:DEPLOYED_CONTRACT]->(p:Pool) WHERE p.total_volume_usd IS NOT NULL RETURN f.address AS from_address, p.address AS to_address, p.labels AS to_labels, p.total_volume_usd AS total_volume_usd, p.tx_total_count AS tx_total_count ORDER BY p.total_volume_usd DESC LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (s:Address)-[f:FLOWED_TO]->(p:Address {address: "0x7615926023bb149f36095645c2a81dc367d39750"}) WHERE NOT s:Pool AND NOT s:Protocol AND NOT s:System RETURN s.address AS from_address, p.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, s.is_contract AS from_is_contract ORDER BY f.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (p:Pool:Launchpad) RETURN p.address AS address, labels(p) AS node_labels, p.labels AS labels LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Mixer) RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x02d9876a21af7545f8632c3af76ec90b5ad4b66d"}) WHERE a:NFT RETURN a.address AS address, a.token_standard AS token_standard, labels(a) AS node_labels LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (p:Address {address: "0x00aea4ccd2a12f955bfae8b8741cbee14d38e755"}) WHERE p:Pool RETURN p.address AS address, labels(p) AS node_labels, p.labels AS labels LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWED_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT mid:Pool AND NOT mid:Protocol AND NOT mid:System AND NOT mid.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS exit_usd LIMIT 25 UNION MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWED_TO|ADDED_LIQUIDITY]->(mid:Pool)-[r2:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, r2.usd AS exit_usd LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[paid:FLOWED_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND NOT victim:Protocol AND NOT victim:System AND NOT victim.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, max(paid.amount_usd_sum) AS paid_in_usd, sum(removal.usd) AS removed_usd, max(removal.receiver_added_usd) AS receiver_added_usd, sum(removal.usd) - max(removal.receiver_added_usd) AS receiver_profit_usd, max(removal.receiver_provided) AS receiver_provided ORDER BY removed_usd DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x966890d38bfd587c9d6fd6123389dfe18ac9de0e"}) RETURN a.address AS address, a.token_standard AS token_standard, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address) WHERE a.address IN ["0x966890d38bfd587c9d6fd6123389dfe18ac9de0e", "0x09e9df72f639875b58dbfd356e31c47b0b87f65b"] RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels, a.token_standard AS token_standard LIMIT 2

USE topology MATCH (exchange:Address)-[r1:FLOWED_TO]->(a:Address) WHERE a.address = "corpus-address-a" AND a.address <> exchange.address AND exchange.is_exchange IS NOT NULL AND NOT a:Pool RETURN "inflow" AS direction, exchange.address AS exchange_address, exchange.labels AS exchange_display_labels, exchange.labels AS exchange_system_labels, a.address AS withdrawal_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count, r1.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, r1.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, [exchange.address, a.address] AS addresses, [{address: exchange.address, network: exchange.network, labels: exchange.labels, system_labels: exchange.labels, is_exchange: exchange.is_exchange, risk_score: exchange.risk_score, risk_level: exchange.risk_level}, {address: a.address, network: a.network, labels: a.labels, system_labels: a.labels, is_exchange: a.is_exchange, risk_score: a.risk_score, risk_level: a.risk_level}] AS path_nodes, [{amount_usd_sum: r1.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r1.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r1.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r1.last_seen_timestamp}] AS edge_props ORDER BY hops ASC LIMIT 200

USE topology MATCH (exchange:Address)-[r1:FLOWED_TO]->(n1:Address)-[r2:FLOWED_TO]->(a:Address) WHERE a.address = "corpus-address-a" AND a.address <> exchange.address AND exchange.is_exchange IS NOT NULL AND n1.is_exchange IS NULL AND NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT n1:Pool AND NOT n1:Protocol AND NOT n1:System AND NOT n1.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] RETURN "inflow" AS direction, exchange.address AS exchange_address, exchange.labels AS exchange_display_labels, exchange.labels AS exchange_system_labels, n1.address AS withdrawal_address, 2 AS hops, r2.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r2.tx_count AS tx_count, r2.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, r2.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, [exchange.address, n1.address, a.address] AS addresses, [{address: exchange.address, network: exchange.network, labels: exchange.labels, system_labels: exchange.labels, is_exchange: exchange.is_exchange, risk_score: exchange.risk_score, risk_level: exchange.risk_level}, {address: n1.address, network: n1.network, labels: n1.labels, system_labels: n1.labels, is_exchange: n1.is_exchange, risk_score: n1.risk_score, risk_level: n1.risk_level}, {address: a.address, network: a.network, labels: a.labels, system_labels: a.labels, is_exchange: a.is_exchange, risk_score: a.risk_score, risk_level: a.risk_level}] AS path_nodes, [{amount_usd_sum: r1.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r1.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r1.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r1.last_seen_timestamp}, {amount_usd_sum: r2.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r2.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r2.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r2.last_seen_timestamp}] AS edge_props ORDER BY hops ASC LIMIT 200

exchange_display_labels, exchange.labels AS exchange_system_labels, n1.address AS withdrawal_address, 3 AS hops, r3.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r3.tx_count AS tx_count, r3.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, r3.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, [exchange.address, n1.address, n2.address, a.address] AS addresses, [{address: exchange.address, network: exchange.network, n1.network, labels: n1.labels, system_labels: n1.labels, is_exchange: n1.is_exchange, risk_score: n1.risk_score, risk_level: n1.risk_level}, {address: n2.address, network: n2.network, labels: n2.labels, system_labels: n2.labels, is_exchange: n2.is_exchange, risk_score: n2.risk_score, risk_level: n2.risk_level}, {address: a.address, network: a.network, labels: a.labels, system_labels: a.labels, is_exchange: a.is_exchange, risk_score: a.risk_score, risk_level: a.risk_level}] AS path_nodes, [{amount_usd_sum: r1.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r1.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r1.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r1.last_seen_timestamp}, {amount_usd_sum: r2.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r2.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r2.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r2.last_seen_timestamp}, {amount_usd_sum: r3.amount_usd_sum, tx_count: r3.tx_count, first_seen_timestamp: r3.first_seen_timestamp, last_seen_timestamp: r3.last_seen_timestamp}] AS edge_props ORDER BY
